title.note: Game title, glossary keep; the guide keeps English game titles unless the developer supplies a Portuguese one.

hud.cast.note: Infinitive button, as pt-PT buttons are; 'lançar (a linha)' is the fishing sense.

hud.reel.note: 'Recolher (a linha)' is the pt-PT fishing verb for reeling in; 8 of 8. 'Puxar' is shorter and plainer for kids, but it has no usable noun for the pass name Auto Reel (glossary: same verb).
hud.reel.blind_remark: on its own the verb means pull in / retract / collect; reads as reeling in only because it replaces Cast during a bite

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1 and 12 all read correctly. 'Isco' is the Portugal word for fishing bait; 'isca' is the Brazilian one.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern ('Novo pet {rarity}: {pet}!'): the masculine rarity agrees with 'peixe', so feminine fish names (Carpa, Enguia) stay correct; avoids the source's 'a {rarity}' problem. 21 visible; 44 with Lendário + Enguia-Lanterna.

catch.escaped.note: Names the generic 'peixe' so the subject is clear in a toast; keeps the trailing '...'.

catch.new_record.note: Developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; pt-PT writes a decimal comma ('12,4'), so the period reads foreign. Format it per locale in code.

fish.golden_carp.note: Item-name capitalization per the guide (nouns and adjectives capitalized, like 'Poção da Sorte').

fish.lantern_eel.note: Translated per glossary, keeping the lantern idea; hyphenated noun-noun species name the way Portuguese forms them (peixe-lanterna, peixe-espada). Feminine noun; safe in catch.success because the rarity agrees with 'peixe'.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine to agree with 'peixe' in catch.success; reads above Lendário (terms.json).

shop.rods.note: 'Cana de pesca' is the Portugal term; 'vara' is Brazilian.

shop.equipped.note: State label; feminine to agree with the rod it sits on ('a cana').

pass.auto_reel.note: Noun of hud.reel's 'Recolher', as the glossary asks. 'Recolha automática' (18) is clearer but over the 14 budget; 'autorrecolha' follows the 1990 spelling rule (auto + r doubles, as in autorretrato). The Creator Hub pass name should match.
pass.auto_reel.blind_remark: coined compound; the noun 'recolha' usually means collection or pickup, so it can read as 'Auto-collect'

pass.lucky_bait.text: O Isco da Sorte duplica as tuas hipóteses de pescar peixes raros!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Article 'O' sits outside the bold so the tag still wraps only the pass name. 'Hipóteses' is the pt-PT word for chances; 'raros' matches the Raro tier.

sell.done.note: Two label forms so count = 1 and coins = 1 stay correct ('1 moedas' would break). 35 visible. Developer: if the game formats coins as '1,250', pt-PT reads it as 1.25; send 1250 or '1 250'.

sell.prompt.note: Tu imperative of premir, per the guide ('Prime E para abrir').

ascend.button.note: 'Ascender' means rising or moving up a rank, not religious; same verb in ascend.confirm. Native check welcome: 'Prestígio' is the other option some games use.

ascend.confirm.text: Ascender agora? Vais recomeçar do zero, mas passas a pescar peixes raros {bonus}% mais vezes.
ascend.confirm.note: 'Passas a pescar' = from then on, carrying the permanent bonus; percent written with no space, per CLDR pt-PT.

weather.storm.text: Tempestade a caminho! Os peixes raros estão a morder o isco.
weather.storm.note: 'Morder o isco' keeps the fishing sense explicit, as the context asks; 'Vem aí uma tempestade!' would put it at 61 of 60. Exactly 60.

quest.catch_n.text: Peixes a pescar na Baía do Luar: {n}
quest.catch_n.note: Label form ('Fish to catch at Moonlit Bay: 10') so n = 1 stays correct; 'Pesca {n} peixes' breaks at 1. Baía do Luar per terms.json (developer chose translate); in-world signs should match.
quest.catch_n.blind_remark: stiff, form-like phrasing; unclear whether {n} is the total goal or how many remain

friends.boost.text: Pescar com amigos dá +{percent}% de sorte

trade.sent.note: No article before the display name, so gender is never guessed.

trade.accept.text: {player} aceitou o teu pedido de troca
trade.accept.note: 'Your trade' rendered as the trade request, per context; no gendered word describes {player}. 30 of 33.

codes.enter.note: Tu imperative fits here (18 of 20); 'Inserir código' (14) is the shorter infinitive fallback the guide uses for a tighter box.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Resgatar' is the guide's word for redeeming codes; 'a recompensa' instead of 'a tua recompensa' keeps it at 41 of 45.

afk.kicked.text: Estiveste demasiado tempo sem te mexer, por isso a pesca parou.
afk.kicked.note: Reworded to avoid 'inativo/inativa', which would need the player's gender. No server removal mentioned, as in the source.
afk.kicked.blind_remark: says only that fishing stopped; nothing about being removed from the server

settings.sfx.note: Sentence case per the guide's house rule.

event.ends.note: Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; pt-PT writes '2 d 4 h', and a minutes 'm' would read as meters. Format durations per locale in code.
event.ends.blind_remark: can also read as 'ends on/at {time}' if {time} is a date or clock time

daily.streak.text: Dias seguidos: {day}! Volta amanhã para mais recompensas.
daily.streak.note: Ordinal ('3.º dia seguido') is how Portuguese says a day streak and is correct for every day value, unlike 'sequência de {day} dias' at 1. 'For more' made explicit as 'mais recompensas'. 51 of 62.
daily.streak.review_reason: The ordinal indicator in "{day}.º" fails lint as a non-Latin letter and is a glyph risk in custom fonts; the label form uses terms.json "dias seguidos" and stays correct at day 1 (52 of 62).

tip.night.text: Dica: alguns peixes só mordem o isco à noite.
tip.night.note: 'Morder o isco' for the fishing sense of bite, same as weather.storm.

group.join.text: Junta-te à nossa comunidade e ganha 50 iscos grátis!
group.join.note: 'Comunidade' is Roblox's own pt word for groups (guide). 'Nossa' because it is the studio's group, as in the guide's reference line. 'For 50 bait' folded into 'e ganha'. 53 of 60.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest' is the heaviest by weight, so 'pesado' says it outright; 'Maior captura' could read as longest. 17 of 18.
